id: \bMy Pokémon has a Hasty Nature. It has a higher Speed stat than my other Pokémon.
en: \bMy Pokémon has a Hasty Nature. It has a higher Speed stat than my other Pokémon.

en: \bMaybe Nature has something to do with how stats grow?
